#| include: false
SRS_SITE_TEXT <- .reportLabel()
if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT) && !is.null(params$site) && length(params$site)) {
  SRS_SITE_TEXT <- trimws(as.character(params$site[[1L]]))
}
if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT) && !is.null(params$location) && length(params$location)) {
  SRS_SITE_TEXT <- trimws(as.character(params$location[[1L]]))
}
if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT)) SRS_SITE_TEXT <- "el proyecto"
CAPTION <- sprintf(
  readCaption("fig.srs.psa.ES"),
  SRS_SITE_TEXT
)
